scripts.build: bun run bin/clean.ts && bun build src/main.ts src/platform/windows/jobs-worker.ts src/platform/windows/guard-worker.ts --target bun --outdir dist --splitting --sourcemap=none --entry-naming [name].[ext] --minify-whitespace --minify-syntax
scripts.build:exe: bun run build && bun run bin/compile.ts
scripts.build:linux: bun run build && bun ../../scripts/ci/bun-version.ts "the Linux core" && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64-baseline --minify-whitespace --minify-syntax src/main.ts --outfile dist/boite-core-linux-x64 && bun run bin/stage-cli.ts
